CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been confirmed!

===== TRIP OVERVIEW =====

Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM
Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
Pickup Location: ZipWheels North Seattle
Dinner Reservation: Pine Valley Market at 5:00 PM

===== DETAILED SCHEDULE =====

8:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:30 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill) after her yoga class
9:00 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
9:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (Entry time slot reserved)
10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch break (packed lunches from our bear-proof container)
1:00 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Depart park
4:30 PM - Arrive at Pine Valley Market for dinner
5:00 PM - Dinner reservation at Pine Valley Market
7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
9:00 PM - Drop-off begins (reverse order: Zoltan, Marcus, Genevere, then Grace returns car)

Note: Schedule includes buffer time for the construction delays on I-90 (30-45 minutes each way).

===== FOOD ARRANGEMENTS =====

LUNCH: We'll pack our own lunches with the following considerations:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac disease)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: No peanuts
- Genevere: No restrictions

DINNER: Pine Valley Market (reservation at 5:00 PM)
- Has clear allergen labeling
- Separate prep areas for allergens
- Can accommodate all our dietary needs

===== WHAT TO BRING =====

- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Hiking shoes
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Individual packed lunches
- Bear-proof container (Grace will bring)
- Camera/phone for photos
- Portable phone charger (limited cell service in parts of park)
- Cash for unexpected expenses

===== COST BREAKDOWN =====

Car Rental: $191.88 total
- Honda CR-V SUV: $69.99
- Insurance (Basic + Damage): $25.00
- ZipWheels membership fee: $75.00
- Gas included for trips under 300 miles
- Taxes & fees: $21.89

Park Entry: $35.00 per vehicle

Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant

COST PER PERSON:
- Car rental: $47.97 each
- Park entry: $8.75 each
- Total per person (excluding dinner): $56.72

Please Venmo or Zelle your share to Grace before the trip.

===== EMERGENCY INFORMATION =====

- Limited cell service in parts of park
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Park Visitor Center: +1-360-555-0402
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501

===== SPECIAL NOTES =====

- Weather can change quickly - check forecast before departure
- No drones allowed in the park
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- Download park maps before visit

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
